invariants.rule: GlassHelix owns scientific models, evidence and inference meaning; Torch supplies ordinary ML. CelleraTorch owns framework integration; native Cellerator owns reusable biological math, differentiation, parameter/value contracts, geometry, planning and compiler/runtime. No parallel GH ML runtime or CT kernel home.

A biology-purpose learning operation needs an explicit model assumption, semantic contract, exact reference and identified computational advantage to test. Biological labels or a generic ML kernel alone do not establish this. Model restrictions are hypotheses, not truths or hardware requirements.

Preserve actual measurement relationships and allowed information. Population snapshots and sibling cells are not individual trajectories; nominal common forcing is not identical intracellular input. No held-out ATAC, future targets or target-derived preprocessing in unauthorized inference.

Keep biological/structure identity independent of physical layout and encoding. Preserve ordered and repeated arguments, actual saved-primal generations, lawful contribution assembly and canonical parameter ownership. Never hide mutation inside the new composable backward.

Preserve successful NF1A, compiler, relation, geometry and CelleraTorch work and separate Todo authorities. No retirement, runtime replacement, old-plan reapply, unrelated cleanup, preprint edits or Ampere-epic activation is authorized.

Use coarse outcomes and evidence-selected alternatives. Reuse ordinary Torch and existing Cellerator compositions before new kernels. Easy work may proceed immediately. A costly design needs an explicit rationale, not a universal framework or mandatory survey.

Separate engineering correctness, scientific adequacy, numerical policy and performance. Searched candidates are not an exhaustive compatible set; no fabricated biology, derivative support, compiler coverage or speedup.

tasks.objective: Closure-only aggregate for the verified local outcomes, not a coordinator seat or prerequisite of children.

required: All local outcomes have executed acceptance and selected-branch evidence. Close last; preserve separate engineering, biological and performance claims.

tasks.title: Make native biological training compose with Torch
tasks.objective: Expose one genuinely composable trainable CT path over current CE owners, replacing assumptions about the old combined N16 backward/update adapter with tested gradient and update semantics.

required: Keep the old explicit combined training route intact. Add/reuse a separate route whose backward returns requested input and parameter gradients without updating learned values; saved forward values must be the values differentiated.

Register real Python/Torch or libtorch operations and a useful module/parameter view; provide the actual Python entry used by the GH consumer. Reuse standard Torch optimizers through a sanctioned update/publication contract with exactly one update authority.

Preserve existing CE canonical native-parameter ownership. Ordinary Torch-only parameters remain Torch-owned. Define lifecycle, mutation/version detection, gradient layout, read completion and value-generation publication; zero-copy alone is not optimizer safety.

Qualify composed outputs and full parameter gradients, repeated/shared use, gradient accumulation before a step, irregular/tail shapes in the selected supported domain, non-default streams, stale operands, lifetime and save/reload. Verify registration separately from mathematical gradients.

Use the existing CE operation/execution/differential/update contracts. Extend only what the chosen trainable route needs; no CT native kernel duplicate, GH optimizer, full tensor framework or forced toolchain upgrade. Publish an installed producer and exact tested capability receipt.

delegated_choices: The existing adapter explicitly mutates in backward and returns no native-parameter Torch gradients. Treat that as a known bounded gap, not permission to discard its tests.
Choose the smallest safe parameter update integration: stock Torch math is preferred, but native ownership/readiness must remain correct. Make any synchronization/packing cost explicit.
Begin obvious integration work immediately; do not wait for biological data or a completed GH model. CPU/straightforward references are allowed; final claimed CUDA route needs real GPU tests.
tasks.next_action: Use the outcome brief and fetch its deeper references only as needed. Bind actual executable acceptance gates once commands exist; finish_task runs them. No inspect/build/retry microtasks.
tasks.notes: Same-repository ordinary decisions stay with this owner. A task label does not grant cross-authority writes. Source drift can justify reusing an already-correct route with executed evidence.

tasks.title: Realize and assess one biology-purpose learning construction
tasks.objective: Turn the scientifically selected structured computation into a reusable CE/CT facility or a justified composition of existing facilities, with exact semantics and complete-cost evidence.

required: Use the worked BIOLOGICAL_ML design and the GH consumer demand to choose one actual computation. Document its biological modeling assumption separately from the native mathematical identity and hardware realization.

Preserve typed domains, logical support, ordered/repeated arguments, whole-candidate identity, value/structure separation and legal contribution assembly as applicable. Dynamic zero values are not automatically structural absence or zero derivative support.

Try an exact composition of existing CE operations with Torch components first. Add a native operator, fusion or compiler lowering only for a demonstrated missing capability or credible measured benefit; a layer is not synonymous with a new CUDA kernel.

Test forward and selected parameter/input/activity derivatives against the same-model reference, including cases that defeat the claimed structural advantage. Benchmark preparation plus forward/backward/update, packing, transfers and memory, not only one favorable kernel.

Expose reusable framework wrappers through CT and keep native math/compiler semantics in CE. Native C++ and .cell/compiler routes must not acquire conflicting meanings; full source-language integration is not required unless selected.

Return implemented, validated, no_change_required or evaluated_not_promoted with evidence. A non-promoted optimization retains a correct reusable path and honest measurements; it must not become an excuse to substitute unrelated generic work.

delegated_choices: The default candidate is context-modulated shared support; change it when the scientific model or measured workload justifies another candidate. Do not implement the whole shortlist.
Cellerator compiler/std-library implementation is legitimate when advantageous; do not build a new GH IR or demand complete compiler modernization.
This outcome can be a composition, reuse and rejection of needless fusion. New native kernels are not a completion quota.
